title: Chilean temporary residence for nationals of the Mercosur Residence Agreement states (Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Paraguay, Uruguay)

Servicio Nacional de Migraciones: dependents of a temporary resident, their documents, and the principal's means measured against the Social Development Ministry's indicators
Civil Code: art. 26, of age at 18 (dieciocho años); art. 48, a period of years started on a day the end month lacks ends on its last day, which also applies to ages
Mercosur, Bolivia and Chile Residence Agreement, as approved by Paraguay's Ley N.º 3578/2008, article 2: nationals by origin, or by naturalization held for five years
Mercosur, Bolivia and Chile Residence Agreement, as approved by Paraguay's Ley N.º 3578/2008, article 4.1: a temporary residence of up to two years, on the documents listed
Mercosur Residence Agreement (Paraguay's Ley N.º 3578/2008), article 4.1, c): no judicial, criminal or police records in the country of origin or where one lived in the 5 years before

requirements.title: National by origin of Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Paraguay or Uruguay, or naturalized there for five years or more

assessments.title: When family members apply as dependents, the principal signs a notarized sworn statement to bear their costs and shows enough means by the Social Development and Family Ministry's indicators
Adults show a criminal record certificate from the country of origin or where they lived in the last 5 years, attached within 60 days of issue; the origin country's is valid 60 days at most

Fee in US dollars, paid in pesos at the official rate: Argentina 250, Brazil 100, Paraguay 288, Uruguay 65; Bolivia none since a 2023-09 agreement (before: 149 in the table, 90 charged); minors exempt
Applied for from abroad only, online on the migration service's digital procedures portal; family members apply as dependents the same way
Passport valid for a year or more from the application (a Bolivian may use a valid identity card); a recent photo; foreign papers apostilled or legalized, and translated unless in Spanish or English
Dependents prove the tie (marriage or cohabitation proof, birth certificate); a child under 18 also needs a parent's notarized care statement, and a stepchild the couple's union proof

dependents.title: The principal's children under 18; older children only with a disability, or between 18 and 24 and studying at an institution the State recognizes, neither of which is recorded: possible
The spouse's children under 18; older children only with a disability, or between 18 and 24 and studying at an institution the State recognizes, neither of which is recorded: possible
The partner's children under 18; older children only with a disability, or between 18 and 24 and studying at an institution the State recognizes, neither of which is recorded: possible

costs.title: USD 15 for each dependent of 18 or over, the fee table's flat fee for a dependent, paid in pesos at the official rate; minors exempt; possible for a Bolivian, whose fee a 2023 agreement waived

durations.title: Mercosur temporary residence: up to two years
